entities.summary: Karmiel is a city in the Northern District of Israel. Established in 1964 as a development town, Karmiel is located in the Beit HaKerem Valley which divides upper and lower Galilee. The city is located south of the Acre–Safed road, 32 kilometres from Safed and 20 km from Ma'alot-Tarshiha and 20 km (12 mi) from Acre. In 2024 Karmiel had a population of 47,941.
